# BigCommerce Storefront authentication fixtures

Sources checked on 2026-10-04:

- [Authentication](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/storefront/guides/graphql-storefront-api/authentication)
- [Customer context](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/storefront/guides/graphql-storefront-api/customer-context)
- [Storefront query reference](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/api-reference/graphql/storefront/queries/site)

`catalog.graphql` is a frozen subset for the adapter's read-only catalog query.
`documented-field-types.json` retains the field types and nullability extracted
from the saved official type reference. All 32 selected fields are cross-checked.
It represents the queried API types, not the complete API or its permission engine.
Money uses the documented BigDecimal scalar. graphql-core validates and executes
queries, including variables and nested selections; invalid fields/arguments fail.
Synthetic products intentionally include zero price, false stock, null product
prices and null variant prices/inventory.

| Documented behavior | Regression coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Bearer token on POST `/graphql` | All modes; no management `X-Auth-Token` |
| Storefront token and CORS origin | Storefront mode headers, canonical Origin fixture |
| Private token for server-to-server, no required Origin | Private mode, no page discovery; default root endpoint |
| Customer access token alongside private token | Dedicated header, mutually exclusive context validation |
| Invalid customer sessions otherwise become anonymous | Strict error header; no anonymous HTML continuation |
| Impersonation token with customer ID | Explicit mode, positive ID header, no customer token mixing |
| Stencil tokens rotate | Public token rediscovered between extractions |
| Server-side tokens must remain private | No public discovery, headers only, redacted errors/evidence/scopes |
| Permissions and validity are enforced by provider | Synthetic expired/revoked/origin/channel rejection responses |
| API failures can occur after successful pages | Retain captured earlier pages, mark incomplete |
| Anonymous API failures can continue into HTML | Actual public extract dispatch with failure retained |

The token family is caller-declared. We do not inspect unsigned JWT claims or
claim to check signatures, channel permissions, expiry, or revocation ourselves.
Negative response bodies are synthetic GraphQL error envelopes. Their labels
identify scenarios, not a claim that BigCommerce always returns a particular HTTP
status or error text for that scenario. Both HTTP errors and HTTP-200 GraphQL
errors are covered, as are partial data, timeout and cross-origin redirects.

Token issuance, login, refresh/revocation, customer/B2B mutations and provider-side
permission verification are outside this read-only extractor. Credentials are
supplied by the caller, not generated by tests. Live authenticated acceptance is
still unverified. Run with `pip install -e '.[dev]'` then
`PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_bigcommerce_auth.py tests/test_storefront_apis.py`.
